entries.description_source_en: Graceful ripples running across the water’s surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.
entries.fact_source_en: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can’t hear its cries of warning.
entries.description_ru: Маленький головастик, общающийся высокочастотными песнями.
entries.fact_ru: Предупреждающие сигналы Тимпоула не слышат ни люди, ни большинство покемонов.

entries.description_source_en: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.
entries.fact_source_en: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.
entries.description_ru: Покемон, ослабляющий добычу мощными звуковыми волнами.
entries.fact_ru: Чем крупнее бугорки Палпитоуда, тем шире диапазон его пения.

entries.description_source_en: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.
entries.fact_source_en: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.
entries.description_ru: Могучая жаба, вызывающая вибрациями подобие землетрясений.
entries.fact_ru: Сейсмитоуд усиливает удары, вибрируя наростами на своих кулаках.

entries.description_source_en: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh’s belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer’s sweat.
entries.fact_source_en: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.
entries.description_ru: Мастер бросков, постоянно совершенствующий боевые приёмы.
entries.fact_ru: Пояс Троха темнеет с каждым боем, впитывая пот владельца.

entries.description_source_en: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it’s best to quietly pass by.
entries.fact_source_en: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.
entries.description_ru: Неутомимый боец, посвящающий жизнь тренировкам.
entries.fact_ru: Если помешать тренировке Суока, он приходит в ярость.

entries.description_source_en: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.
entries.fact_source_en: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
entries.description_ru: Маленький портной, создающий одежду из листьев.
entries.fact_ru: Севаддл сшивает листья клейкой нитью, выделяемой изо рта.

entries.description_source_en: Preferring dark, damp places, it spends the entire day eating fallen leaves that lie around it.
entries.fact_source_en: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
entries.description_ru: Покемон, скрывающийся в тёмных влажных местах среди опавшей листвы.
entries.fact_ru: Леса со Свадлунами отличаются особенно густой и здоровой растительностью.

entries.description_source_en: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.
entries.fact_source_en: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
entries.description_ru: Заботливый покемон, шьющий одежду для маленьких существ.
entries.fact_ru: Ливанни использует липкий шёлк и острые передние лапы как ножницы.

entries.description_source_en: Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species, but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.
entries.fact_source_en: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.
entries.description_ru: Ядовитая многоножка с очень агрессивным характером.
entries.fact_ru: Венипиды яростно сражаются с Сиззлипидами при встрече.

entries.description_source_en: This Pokémon spins itself rapidly and charges into its opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph.
entries.fact_source_en: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it’ll need for evolution.
entries.description_ru: Покемон, вращающийся с огромной скоростью при атаке.
entries.fact_ru: Вирлипид копит энергию для эволюции под защитой прочного панциря.

entries.description_source_en: Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws on its neck before slamming them into the ground and jabbing them with its claws’ toxic spikes.
entries.fact_source_en: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.
entries.description_ru: Гигантская многоножка, поражающая добычу ядовитыми шипами.
entries.fact_ru: Сколипиды ведут ожесточённые территориальные войны с Сентискорчами.

entries.description_source_en: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.
entries.fact_source_en: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can’t move as well.
entries.description_ru: Маленький хлопковый покемон, защищающийся пушистыми волокнами.
entries.fact_ru: Под дождём хлопок Коттони намокает и сильно утяжеляет его.

entries.description_source_en: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it’ll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.
entries.fact_source_en: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.
entries.description_ru: Озорной покемон, разбрасывающий хлопок ради забавы.
entries.fact_ru: На солнце хлопок Вимсикотта постоянно отрастает заново.

entries.description_source_en: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.
entries.fact_source_en: Petilil appears around sources of clean water. Boiling leaves from this Pokémon’s head results in a liquid that’s sometimes used as a bug repellent.
entries.description_ru: Лекарственное растение-покемон с ценными листьями.
entries.fact_ru: Отвар из листьев Петилил иногда используют как средство от насекомых.

entries.description_source_en: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.
entries.fact_source_en: It’s well liked by other Pokémon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.
entries.description_ru: Изящный цветочный покемон, вдохновляющий окружающих своим ароматом.
entries.fact_ru: Цветок на голове Лиллигант требует постоянного ухода.

entries.description_source_en: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.
entries.fact_source_en: In the past, it often appeared on the dinner table. The meat of red-striped Basculin is on the fatty side, and it’s more popular with the youth.
entries.description_ru: Рыба-покемон, имеющая несколько региональных форм.
entries.fact_ru: Краснополосые Баскулины когда-то считались популярной пищевой рыбой.

entries.description_source_en: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.
entries.fact_source_en: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it’s swimming.
entries.description_ru: Пустынный крокодил, скрывающийся в песке по ночам.
entries.fact_ru: Сэндайл передвигается по песку так, словно плывёт.

entries.description_source_en: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.
entries.fact_source_en: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won’t move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.
entries.description_ru: Хищник с отличным ночным зрением.
entries.fact_ru: Несмотря на острые глаза, Крокорок ночью почти не двигается из-за холода.

entries.description_source_en: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile’s mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.
entries.fact_source_en: When it spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swims through the desert as if it were water, then jumps out and chomps them.
entries.description_ru: Грозный властелин пустыни с невероятно мощными челюстями.
entries.fact_ru: Крукодайл замечает добычу за десятки километров.

entries.description_source_en: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.
entries.fact_source_en: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
entries.description_ru: Огненный покемон, чья сила зависит от внутреннего пламени.
entries.fact_ru: Когда внутренний огонь Дарумаки угасает, он сразу засыпает.

entries.description_source_en: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.
entries.fact_source_en: Its internal fire burns at 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
entries.description_ru: Пылкий боец, способный разрушить грузовик одним ударом.
entries.fact_ru: Температура внутреннего пламени Дарманитана достигает около 1400 °C.

entries.description_source_en: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.
entries.fact_source_en: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.
entries.description_ru: Весёлый кактус, отбивающий ритм словно маракасами.
entries.fact_ru: Семена Марактуса чрезвычайно питательны и ценятся в пустыне.

entries.description_source_en: When it finds a stone appealing, it creates a hole inside it and uses it as its home. This Pokémon is the natural enemy of Roggenrola and Rolycoly.
entries.fact_source_en: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.
entries.description_ru: Краб-отшельник, выбирающий камни в качестве дома.
entries.fact_ru: Если подходящего камня нет, Двеббл может поселиться в отверстиях на теле Гипподона.

entries.description_source_en: This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry climates. It won’t come out of its boulder on rainy days.
entries.fact_source_en: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.
entries.description_ru: Сильный покемон, носящий на себе огромный валун.
entries.fact_ru: Крастл способен многие дни переносить тяжёлые каменные плиты.

entries.description_source_en: If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokémon.
entries.fact_source_en: It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.
entries.description_ru: Задиристый покемон, любящий бодаться со всеми подряд.
entries.fact_ru: Прочная кожа Скрэгги растягивается по мере его взросления и эволюции.
